Intro: Just like that. Like we're in the fucking trenches again. A single lit fuse, and the blood sprays like fireworks.
That…isn't what I wanted. None of this is what I wanted.
This "resistance" is fractured into factions, brothers turning on one another if it means getting a leg up. To eat the weakest. To lift the strong on the backs of the sick.
There's someone…calls himself some sort of "messiah". He's rotting by the day. I've never seen his face, not really. Shadows eat him up.
I don't know why that old man lets him on that radio. Giving people like that a platform just to preach violence on a soapbox—I can't stand it.
Maybe there are some people beyond saving.
